title: Clause Commentary — The Running Share of a New Plant, Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions
content:
# The Running Share of a New Plant

Commentary on the clause fixing how much of a retrofit's reduction stands when the baseline of a subscription under Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions is restated. The ramp months are 12; a full year is 12 months and a half year 6 months.

## Clause

Where the closed project at the building closed inside the ramp months ending on the day of the reset and the tier trues measured savings up once a year, the running share is the whole months since it closed, of a full year. Where the closed project closed inside those ramp months and the tier trues measured savings up more often than once a year, the running share is the whole months since it closed, of a half year, and never more than the whole. In every other case the running share is the whole of the reduction, because a plant that has run the whole year carries its whole reduction.

## Commentary

**The ramp test.** The whole months from the completion date of the closed project at the building, recorded under Equipment Replacement & Retrofit Projects, to the day of the reset. Twelve whole months or fewer is inside the ramp months; more than twelve is outside, and the third limb governs.

**Inside the ramp, annual true-up.** The running share is those whole months divided by 12. Four whole months since the close gives 4 of 12, that is 33.33 percent.

**Inside the ramp, a true-up more often than once a year — half-yearly or quarterly.** The running share is those whole months divided by 6, and never more than the whole: 4 whole months gives 4 of 6, that is 66.67 percent, while 7 whole months would give more than the whole and is held at 100 percent.

**Outside the ramp, and every other case.** The whole of the reduction, 100 percent.

## Table

| Whole months since the project closed | True-up frequency fixed for the tier | Running share |
|---|---|---|
| 12 or fewer | annual | those months, of 12 |
| 12 or fewer | semiannual or quarterly | those months, of 6, held at 100 percent |
| more than 12 | any | 100 percent |
